Situated at the base of Mount Ushigase, the approach to the shrine connects with the Chizu Highway. The precincts are home to hundreds of maple trees, the shrine's emblem, which attract many visitors during the autumn foliage season.

Since {{ill|1782|ab|1782|af|1782|als|1782|am|1782 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1782|ar|1782|ary|1782|arz|1782|ast|1782|avk|1782|az|1782|azb|۱۷۸۲ (میلادی)|ba|1782 йыл|ban|1782|bcl|1782|be|1782|be_x_old|1782|bg|1782|bn|১৭৮২|bo|༡༧༨༢ལོ།|bpy|মারি ১৭৮২|br|1782|bs|1782.|ca|1782|cdo|1782 nièng|ceb|1782|ckb|١٧٨٢|co|1782|crh|1782|cs|1782|csb|1782|cv|1782|cy|1782|da|1782|de|1782|diq|1782|el|1782|eml|1782|eo|1782|es|1782|et|1782|eu|1782|fa|۱۷۸۲ (میلادی)|fi|1782|fo|1782|fr|1782|frp|1782|frr|1782|fur|1782|fy|1782|ga|1782|gan|1782年|gcr|1782|gd|1782|gl|1782|gv|1782|he|1782|hi|१७८२|hif|1782|hr|1782.|hsb|1782|ht|1782 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1782|hy|1782|hyw|1782 թուական|ia|1782|id|1782|ilo|1782|io|1782|is|1782|it|1782|ja|1782年|jbo|1782moi|jv|1782|ka|1782|kaa|1782|kk|1782 жыл|kn|೧೭೮೨|ko|1782년|krc|1782 джыл|ksh|Joohr 1782|kv|1782-ӧд во|la|1782|lb|1782|lez|1782 йис|li|1782|lij|1782|lmo|1782|lt|1782 m.|lv|1782. gads|mai|१७८२|map_bms|1782|mdf|1782|mg|1782|mhr|1782|mi|1782|min|1782|mk|1782|mn|1782 он|mr|इ.स. १७८२|mrj|1782 и|ms|1782|my|၁၇၈၂|myv|1782 ие|mzn|۱۷۸۲|nah|1782|nap|1782|nds|1782|new|सन् १७८२|nl|1782|nn|1782|no|1782|nrm|1782|nso|1782|oc|1782|olo|1782|or|୧୭୮୨|os|1782-æм аз|pa|1782|pap|1782|pl|1782|pnb|1782|pt|1782|qu|1782|ro|1782|ru|1782 год|rue|1782|sa|१७८२|sah|1782|scn|1782|sd|1782ع|se|1782|sh|1782.|shn|1782|simple|1782|sk|1782|sl|1782|smn|1782|sq|1782|sr|1782|su|1782|sv|1782|sw|1782|szl|1782|ta|1782|te|1782|tg|Соли 1782|th|พ.ศ. 2325|tk|1782|tl|1782|tly|1782|tr|1782|tt|1782 ел|ug|1782 - يىلى|uk|1782|ur|1782ء|uz|1782|vec|1782|vi|1782|vls|1782|vo|1782|wa|1782|war|1782|wuu|1782年|xmf|1782|yi|1782|zh|1782年|zh_min_nan|1782 nî|zh_yue|1782年|qid=Q7740|lt=1782}} (2nd year of Tenmei), the "Hashira festival," modeled after the [[Onbashira festival]] of {{ill|Suwa-taisha|abstract|Q218813|de|Suwa-Taisha|es|Suwa taisha|eu|Suwa taisha|fa|زیارتگاه بزرگ سووا|fr|Suwa-taisha|hu|Szuva templom|id|Kuil Suwa|it|Santuario di Suwa (Sohonsha)|ja|諏訪大社|ko|스와 대사|lt|Suvos maldykla|pl|Suwa Taisha|ru|Сува-тайся|simple|Suwa-taisha|tr|Suwa-taisha|zh|諏訪大社|qid=Q218813|lt=Suwa taisha}} in {{ill|Shinano Province|ckb|پارێزگای شینانۆ|cs|Provincie Šinano|de|Provinz Shinano|eo|Provinco Ŝinano|es|Provincia de Shinano|fa|ولایت شینانو|fr|Province de Shinano|gl|Provincia de Shinano|hak|Shinano-koet|id|Provinsi Shinano|it|Shinano (provincia)|ja|信濃国|knc|Shinano Province|ko|시나노국|lt|Šinano žemė|ms|Wilayah Shinano|nl|Shinano (provincie)|pl|Prowincja Shinano|pt|Província de Shinano|ru|Синано (провинция)|simple|Shinano Province|sk|Šinano (provincia)|sr|Провинција Шинано|th|แคว้นชินาโนะ|tr|Shinano (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Сінано|zh|信濃國|zh_min_nan|Sinano-kok|zh_yue|信濃國|qid=Q289250|lt=Shinano Province}}, has been held every six years in the years of the Monkey and Tiger in the lunar calendar. During the festival, four cedar logs are cut from the designated mountains, paraded through the town, and erected at the four corners of the main hall.

On March 23, {{ill|2001|ab|2001|af|2001|als|2001|am|2001 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|2001|ar|2001|ary|2001|arz|2001|ast|2001|av|2001 сон|avk|2001|az|2001|azb|۲۰۰۱ (میلادی)|ba|2001 йыл|ban|2001|bat_smg|2001|bcl|2001|be|2001|be_x_old|2001|bg|2001|bh|2001|bjn|2001|bn|২০০১|bo|༢༠༠༡ལོ།|bpy|মারি ২০০১|br|2001|bs|2001.|ca|2001|cdo|2001 nièng|ce|2001 шо|ceb|2001|ckb|٢٠٠١|co|2001|crh|2001|cs|2001|csb|2001|cv|2001|cy|2001|da|2001|de|2001|diq|2001|dv|2001|el|2001|eml|2001|eo|2001|es|2001|et|2001|eu|2001|ext|2001|fa|۲۰۰۱|fi|2001|fiu_vro|2001|fo|2001|fr|2001|frp|2001|frr|2001|fur|2001|fy|2001|ga|2001|gag|2001|gan|2001年|gcr|2001|gd|2001|gl|2001|gn|2001|gu|૨૦૦૧|gv|2001|ha|2001|hak|2001-ngièn|haw|2001|he|2001|hi|२००१|hif|2001|hr|2001.|hsb|2001|ht|2001 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|2001|hy|2001|hyw|2001 թուական|ia|2001|id|2001|ig|2001|ilo|2001|inh|2001 шу|io|2001|is|2001|it|2001|ja|2001年|jbo|2001moi|jv|2001|ka|2001|kaa|2001|kbp|2001|kk|2001 жыл|km|ឆ្នាំ ២០០១|kn|೨೦೦೧|ko|2001년|krc|2001 джыл|ks|2001|ksh|Joohr 2001|ku|2001|kv|2001-ӧд во|kw|2001|la|2001|lb|2001|lez|2001 йис|lg|2001|li|2001|lij|2001|lld|2001|lmo|2001|ln|2001|lt|2001 m.|lv|2001. gads|mai|२००१|map_bms|2001|mdf|2001|mg|2001|mhr|2001|mi|2001|min|2001|mk|2001|ml|2001|mn|2001 он|mr|इ.स. २००१|mrj|2001 и|ms|2001|my|၂၀၀၁|myv|2001 ие|mzn|۲۰۰۱|nah|2001|nap|2001|nds|2001|nds_nl|2001|new|सन् २००१|nl|2001|nn|2001|no|2001|nrm|2001|nso|2001|oc|2001|olo|2001|or|୨୦୦୧|os|2001-æм аз|pa|2001|pag|2001|pam|2001|pap|2001|pl|2001|pms|2001|pnb|2001|pt|2001|qu|2001|rm|2001|ro|2001|roa_rup|2001|roa_tara|2001|ru|2001 год|rue|2001|sah|2001|sc|2001|scn|2001|sco|2001|sd|2001ع|se|2001|sh|2001.|shn|2001|si|2001|simple|2001|sk|2001|sl|2001|smn|2001|sn|2001|so|2001|sq|2001|sr|2001|stq|2001|su|2001|sv|2001|sw|2001|szl|2001|ta|2001|te|2001|tet|2001|th|พ.ศ. 2544|tk|2001|tl|2001|tly|2001|tpi|2001|tr|2001|tt|2001 ел|ty|2001|tyv|2001 чыл|udm|2001 ар|ug|2001 - يىلى|uk|2001|ur|2001ء|uz|2001|vec|2001|vi|2001|vls|2001|vo|2001|wa|2001|war|2001|wuu|2001年|xmf|2001|yi|2001|yo|2001|za|2001 nienz|zea|2001|zh|2001年|zh_classical|二〇〇一年|zh_min_nan|2001 nî|zh_yue|2001年|zu|2001|qid=Q1988|lt=2001}} (13th year of Heisei), the Hashira festival of Suwa Shrine was designated as an Intangible Folk Cultural Property by Tottori Prefecture<ref>[http://db.pref.tottori.jp/bunkazainavi.nsf/bunkazai_web_view/FD8385FB128EC7254925796F0007FF81?OpenDocument Suwa Shrine Hashira festival] Tottori Prefecture Education Committee, accessed April 29, 2015</ref><ref>[https://www1.town.chizu.tottori.jp/chizu/kyouiku/27/bunkazai/ Cultural Properties of Chizu Town] Chizu Town, accessed April 29, 2015</ref>.

== Cultural Properties ==
=== Tottori Prefecture Intangible Folk Cultural Property ===
* **Hashira festival of Suwa Shrine** - Designated on March 23, 2001 (13th year of Heisei)

=== Chizu Town Protected Cultural Property ===
* **map of Chizu Inn** (Ancient Document) - Designated on November 25, 1987 (62nd year of Shōwa)

== Notable Individuals ==
* **Kokubei Taishi** - A sculptor. His mother was the daughter of a Suwa Shrine priest.

== Access ==
* 15-minute walk from {{ill|Chizu Station|fr|Gare de Chizu|ja|智頭駅|jv|Setatsiyun Chizu|ko|지즈역|my|ချိဇုဘူတာ|ur|چِیزو اسٹیشن|zh|智頭站|qid=Q5102669|lt=Chizu Station}} on the {{ill|Chizu Express|fa|چیزو اکسپرس|fr|Chizu Express|it|Chizu Express|ja|智頭急行|ko|지즈 급행|zh|智頭急行|qid=Q4133832|lt=Chizu Express}} or JR {{ill|Inbi Line|fr|Ligne Inbi|it|Linea Inbi|ja|因美線|ko|인비선|zh|因美線|qid=Q899509|lt=Inbi Line}}
